top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs the two achievements I judge most settled. Palladium-catalyzed C-N coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig) is a mature, ligand-controlled, mechanistically understood and independently confirmed method with a clean two-name credit and Kosugi's stoichiometric tin chemistry correctly excluded. Base editing (Liu) is a designed chemical conversion of a DNA base, distinct from the 2020 CRISPR cleavage prize, and it already has real consequences, though it is young and Liu-alone omits Komor, Gaudelli, Kondo and Nishida. Targeted protein degradation (P003) is next, but no degrader is approved and the cereblon strand is unallocated; perovskites (P002) have unresolved stability and credit; phase separation (P004) rests on contested in vivo evidence; no award is last because P001 is defensible.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my ties are to Arieh Warshel and Uppsala ribosome/structural biology groups, none of whom is credited in any proposal
